nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=68 beats='Miri arrives at school to care for three hens for the holiday; Penny is the smallest, Bella is brown, and Ruby is red'>>

choices.label: Start the day with the hens

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri feeds all three hens and watches Bella and Ruby stay near the coop while curious Penny wanders to the garden'>>

choices.label: Let Penny explore while she watches

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=69 beats='At sunset Miri calls all three hens back and counts them into the coop for bed; everyone is safe and sound'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Next morning Miri opens the coop to find Bella and Ruby pecking but Penny is gone; her worry turns to panic'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Miri searches the garden and finds feathers under the oak tree; she follows a trail of feathers past the fence'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Mrs. Chen listens with concern and helps Miri search the school grounds and parking area together'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='At the playground Miri walks slowly checking under the slide and by the climbing frame; she hears a faint clucking from a corner'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Through the gap Miri sees Penny in the field grazing on grass; she calls out and Penny runs back through'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='In the shed Miri finds Penny sitting frightened on straw; a bucket fell blocking the door from outside'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='The kind neighbor remembers seeing Penny and leads Miri to her vegetable garden where Penny enjoys eating tender leaves'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Miri searches the school yard and finds Penny under a bench behind the gym building resting quietly'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Following the sound Miri finds Penny scratching contentedly under the slide; she looks healthy and happy'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=67 beats='Behind the equipment in a hedge Miri spots Penny eating berries; she seems content and lets Miri pick her up'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='In the sandbox Miri finds Penny taking a dust bath and looking very content; she has been safe and happy all along'>>
